expenseRules.title: Deduction rule
expenseRules.intro: A rule proposes the highest deduction the law allows. You may enter less, never more; without a rule you enter the amounts yourself.
expenseRules.areaHint: Floor area used for the activity as a share of the whole home. The same share applies to IVA.
expenseRules.evidencePrompt: The application cannot check this evidence. Confirm that you keep the bank statement or receipt showing the payment.
expenseRules.copied: The proposal is in the IRPF and IVA fields. Run the preview again before posting.
expenseRules.saveToRecalculate: Unsaved changes: save the draft to recalculate the proposal.
expenseRules.saveToCalculate: Save the draft to calculate the proposal for this rule.
expenseRules.status.out_of_scope: The rule does not cover this expense; choose no rule
expenseRules.status.unavailable: The rule is not in this version of the catalog
expenseRules.rule.home_utility_partial_d: Supplies of the habitual home partly used for work
expenseRules.rule.home_rent_partial_dwel: Rent of a home partly used for work
expenseRules.riskReason.general_business: The whole expense must relate to the activity; confirm the business purpose and the complete invoice.
expenseRules.riskReason.social_security_: Only your own RETA contributions for this activity; contributions carry no IVA.
expenseRules.riskReason.home_utility_par: Only for your habitual home partly used for the activity. The IVA share reuses the floor-area share, while LIVA art. 95 as read by TEAC 00/06654/2022 and DGT V2554-23 asks for the share of actual use, which you must prove; IVA also needs a complete invoice. The 30% IRPF coefficient applies unless another percentage is proven; to claim a proven different percentage, choose no rule.
expenseRules.riskReason.home_rent_partia: DGT V1293-25 was read only through a secondary source. The business space must be usable independently, with personal use only incidental. Leases of a dwelling are usually IVA-exempt (LIVA art. 20.Uno.23.º b); the IVA share applies only when the invoice charges IVA, and then only with a complete invoice.
expenseRules.riskReason.health_insurance: Only you, your spouse and children under 25 living with you count. The yearly cap subtracts only postings linked to this rule; premiums posted without it are not counted.
expenseRules.riskReason.own_meals: Only your own meals in restaurants or hotels while carrying out the activity, paid electronically; the business link, date and place must be provable. One draft covers one day. The higher overnight limits apply only to a stay in a municipality other than both your usual workplace and your home; AEAT guidance for the self-employed sets no municipality condition for the lower limits. The daily cap subtracts only postings linked to this rule on the same date. IVA needs a complete invoice and follows the IRPF deduction. Above the daily cap, only the IVA in proportion to the deductible part may be deducted.
expenseRules.riskReason.fine_or_surcharg: Fines, sanctions, enforcement-period surcharges and late-filing surcharges are never deductible. Late-payment interest is outside this rule.
expenseRules.fact.area_share: Floor-area share used for the activity, %
expenseRules.fact.persons: Insured persons (you, spouse, children under 25 living with you)
expenseRules.fact.overnight: Overnight stay in a municipality other than your usual workplace and home
expenseRules.fact.electronic_payment: Paid by card or another electronic means
expenseRules.fact.evidence_confirmed: I keep the bank statement or receipt proving the payment
expenseRules.code.rule_unknown: This rule is not in the installed catalog.
expenseRules.code.rule_not_valid_on_date: The rule applies from {valid_from}{valid_to, select, none {} other { to {valid_to}}}; the expense is dated {transaction_date}.
expenseRules.code.equipment_not_covered: The rule does not cover equipment; choose no rule for the equipment branch.
expenseRules.code.one_day_per_draft: This draft covers {days} days; the meal rule takes one day per draft. Choose no rule or split the expense.
expenseRules.code.irpf_never: Not deductible for IRPF under any conditions.
expenseRules.code.electronic_payment_req: Meals paid without an electronic payment are not deductible.
expenseRules.code.vat_proportional_area: IVA: {share}% of the invoice IVA (floor-area share).
expenseRules.code.vat_manual: IVA: decide yourself; the rule sets no ceiling.
expenseRules.code.evidence_missing: No complete invoice (document type F1, F3 or a rectifying R1–R4), so no IVA can be deducted.
expenseRules.code.evidence_confirmed_by_: You confirmed the proof of payment.
expenseRules.code.irpf_coefficient_times: IRPF: {coefficient}% of the floor-area share of {share}%.
expenseRules.code.unrecovered_vat_added: IVA not recovered, {amount}, is added to the IRPF cost.
expenseRules.code.irpf_person_cap: Yearly cap {cap} for {persons} persons ({persons_disabled} with disability); already posted under this rule in {year}: {used}.
expenseRules.code.irpf_day_cap: Daily cap {per_day}; already posted under this rule on {transaction_date}: {used}.
expenseRules.code.cap_counts_rule_postin: The cap subtracts only earlier postings made under this rule; check postings made without it yourself.
expenseRules.code.cap_exhausted: The cap is used up, so IVA is not deductible either.
expenseRules.copyPair: Copy writes IRPF {irpf} and IVA {vat} into the fields.
expenseRules.copyPairIrpfOnly: Copy writes IRPF {irpf} into its field; IVA stays as you entered it.
